# Iran

`ghost_faction_iran`

A content pack: 200 unit classes and 6 weapon and item classes. No scripted behaviour.

## Requires

- `ghost_main`
- `ghost_vests`
- `ghost_weapons`
- `ghost_uniform`
- `ghost_vehicle`

Carries `skipWhenMissingDependencies` - the PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when something above is absent.

## Ships

156 unit classes, 4 weapon/item classes.
